goal: FG-515: split cohesive owners and preserve native read, rule and replay facts

components.summary: Read map and target contracts, static rules, finite ports and the canonical test tree with file-validated duration inputs. Own shared static call-graph reachability and model selection.
responsibilities: load, validate and save the map, fingerprints and current-model digests; memoize only parsed contracts by source identity
resolve component parents in one layer without loops
merge the target overlay, validate its remove intents and compare it with current
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions and identify formula edits without a corresponding format change
register contract models, build the model tree and locate siblings whose parent projection ignores a newly received value
count import-like strings and injected attribute calls as dependency evidence
Reuse component file matches, test calls and read-only model trees for identical content within one command, returning fresh mutable call/file collections.

components.summary: Check architecture, implementation coverage, model bindings, size and declared replay calls against the current source.
responsibilities: check anchors, files, imports, flow steps and models against the code Distinguish legacy fingerprint migration from real source staleness, using the same strict severity.
report one owner per entrypoint, responsibility, state and side effect
lint cycles, layers, sizes and private names, then apply accepted debts
explain entrypoints and state writers by model, test or reason

components.summary: Manage one target, classify current findings and native gaps, and promote only fresh complete code/model/test checks.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target; move tracked in-place edits safely and retain current files otherwise

classify merged-tree design errors, semantic rule changes, moved rules and native gaps before or after code changes; run the changed target models own bound tests and reject unreceived escalated outputs
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
refuse a target that changes nothing, drops a promise or leaves it untied
promote checked bytes atomically with transient recovery copies and name draft or stale components to confirm; list re-reads and deletions
warn about earlier findings, stale debts, untested rules, fingerprint-format changes and siblings that ignore a newly received parent field
include function-selected models and tests in the single promotion check
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Detect changed paths through a read-only Git index that preserves timestamp checks; select affected functions, ports, literals and tests. Present selected pytest work as counted summaries, with exact commands on explicit verbose requests. Name literal code sites before model sites, ignore moved values by source role, and select newly mapped tests for settings-only map edits.
responsibilities: select the checks a change needs and list its unexplained functions
select owned or closest reachable changed functions and matching flows; print relied models without selecting them
select bound and directly calling test functions, with conservative whole-file fallback
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

components.summary: Show complete component and model views, field lifecycles, exact code ownership, distinct model relations and counted test positions without importing models.
responsibilities: show the tree, Mermaid and digests with static facets and coverage; find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths; compare current and target rules and known-bad definitions by name
find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths
compare current and target facets and list the rules a target changes
show the model rules and flows each component relies on

components.summary: Run fresh model proofs and bound tests, clean owned process groups within the outer session deadline, and report time as advice.
responsibilities: run every model, system included, with known-bad and conformance checks Run independent model subprocesses with explicit concurrency and retain registry order, with system last.
fail a model whose rule no known-bad variant breaks
read code facts for conformance and fail missing or unconsulted anchors; count child projections from one fresh parent exploration per sibling group
clean up model and pytest shard subprocesses in bounded time
run bound tests per item and require each to reach an anchor
show passing proofs on one line, retain every failure and warning, and group timing advice once per advice limit
Run model subprocesses in registration order, directly in the calling thread for one job and with a thread pool for explicit parallel jobs; library defaults stay serial.
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested
